card.title: We Know the Old Rules
card.instruction: Use an old custom you learned together as the deepest proof of connection, even when the present situation has changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You haven't given me our old knock before coming in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The key opens the door. The knock tells me it's you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can see me through the glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And yet I haven't heard from my best friend.

mechanism: A insists on the old knock even after a key and visible recognition make it unnecessary, because the custom signifies the friend rather than access.
confusable: Unlike suspicion about identity, A knows who is present and values the learned shared sound as proof of the connection.
comparison: The knock alternative distinguishes access and recognition from friendship; the bread alternative distinguishes total food from the act of sharing.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
